query_original: What percentage of the race winner's completed laps must a car have covered to be classified at the end of a race?
resposta: According to section 3.3b, a car must have covered at least 90% of the number of laps completed by the winner (rounded down to the nearest whole number of laps) to be classified at the end of a race.
